description: Cockpit section only of OV-1D c/n 27D (ex US Army 69-17012), Ejército Argentino from 1994, dismantled April 2019; cabin preserved at General Rodríguez and donated to the UNLP aeronautics department 7 July 2023 as a teaching aid with working landing-gear demonstration.
